newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks expected range-bound after recent gains.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks expected range-bound after recent gains.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to trade narrowly on Tuesday following a five-day winning streak, with some downside seen after the Hang Seng Index bumped against resistance around 12,700 points on Monday, brokers said.
"Overall we may find a little weakness. I would say we will see a range of about 12,500 to 12,600 points," said Kent Rossiter, institutional sales manager at Nikko Securities.
The Hang Seng Index rose 84.86 points to 12,626.04 on Monday. Later, the Hang Seng London Reference Index of Hong Kong stocks traded in London gained 16.26 points to 12,642.30.
"Probably after this rally we have come to a resistance level so the upside is limited," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
He said the market was likely to remain at current levels on Tuesday and stay in a holding pattern over the next few days.

Delta Asia Securities research manager Ricky Tam said continued momentum in the property sector could provide some upside on Tuesday but most property stocks were likely to meet resistance in the near term.
"I think the market might be slightly higher," he said.
